work.company: Hawaii Department of Transportation, Harbors Division
work.position: Student Intern I - AI Process Automation
work.summary: AI-assisted automation for construction management workflows
highlights: Built a Construction Management Audit Tracker that extracts and reformats contract data across all filetypes, cutting review of 55 contracts (3,000 files) from 11 hours by hand to roughly 28 minutes

Selected as a featured student presenter for the Harbors Division at the HDOT Intern Recognition Summit, presenting a 7-intern team project on AI-assisted construction management; earned a return offer for Fall 2026

work.company: University of Hawaii at Manoa, ResNet
work.summary: Residential network support and infrastructure maintenance
highlights: Developed an automated, real-time service request monitoring system in Python on a Raspberry Pi, polling an API for status data and toggling USB port power via uhubctl to drive LED indicators
Diagnosed network connectivity issues using Etherscope, LinkRunner, and the Airwave management platform
Maintained Aruba 535 APs and Cisco/Aruba switches, performing manual bootstrapping over serial console to restore service
Managed the technical and customer support lifecycle through the Pilikia ticketing system, coordinating with supervisors and end users on wired and wireless incidents
Co-developed a Java (WPILib) swerve drive system with NEO motors and Spark Max controllers, tuning PID and feedforward loops via SysID
Programmed autonomous routines using PathPlanner and Limelight vision
Maintained the team's GitHub repository and inline documentation

volunteer.summary: Volunteer rhythm game project built in partnership with the LazuLight Anniversary Web Development Team
highlights: Directed a 12-person volunteer team of programmers, artists, and composers through a six-month build cycle, scaling up from a 3-person prototype
Produced a trailer that secured an official partnership with the LazuLight Anniversary Web Development Team
Coordinated an on-schedule launch and marketing effort, reaching 26,000+ views, 2,200+ downloads, and 600+ likes
